# AI Daily Digest — 2026-05-10

## 今日のハイライト
- **エージェント型検索の革命 (DCI)**: 従来の埋め込み検索を完全に廃し、grep・シェルコマンドで生コーパスに直接アクセスする手法が BRIGHT/BEIR で SOTA を達成。強いエージェントには「検索 API」より「ターミナルアクセス」が有効であることを示す重大な示唆。
- **Claude Code v2.1.136 の大規模バグ修正**: MCP OAuth の二重リフレッシュ問題・VSCode /clear 後の接続消失・アンダースコアパスでの --resume 不具合など、実運用に直結するバグが一挙修正。企業ユーザーの安定性が大幅向上。
- **EMO — モジュラー MoE の実現**: 25% のエキスパートだけで精度低下 1% に抑えることに成功した新しい MoE 設計。エキスパートがセマンティックレベルで自然に専門化する現象を発見し、メモリ効率的な LLM 展開への道を開く。

papers.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Rethinking Retrieval for Agentic Search via Direct Corpus Interaction
papers.abstract: Modern retrieval systems expose a corpus through a fixed similarity interface. For agentic search, this becomes a bottleneck. DCI proposes direct corpus interaction via terminal tools.

papers.title: RaguTeam at SemEval-2026 Task 8
papers.abstract: Winning system for SemEval-2026 Task 8 MTRAGEval. Heterogeneous ensemble of 7 LLMs ranked 1st out of 26 teams with score 0.7827.

papers.title: When to Trust Imagination: Adaptive Action Execution for World Action Models
papers.abstract: FFDC verifier for adaptive WAM execution. Reduces forward passes by 69% while improving success rate.

papers.title: Audio-Visual Intelligence in Large Foundation Models
papers.abstract: First comprehensive survey of AVI through the lens of large foundation models.

papers.title: StraTA: Incentivizing Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Strategic Trajectory Abstraction
papers.abstract: Strategic Trajectory Abstraction for agentic RL. ALFWorld 93.1%, WebShop 84.2%.

papers.title: RemoteZero: Geospatial Reasoning with Zero Human Annotations
papers.abstract: Box-supervision-free framework for geospatial reasoning using semantic verification.

papers.title: EMO: Pretraining Mixture of Experts for Emergent Modularity
papers.abstract: MoE designed for modularity. 25% experts retain 99% performance vs standard MoE collapse.

papers.title: PianoCoRe: Combined and Refined Piano MIDI Dataset
papers.abstract: 250,046 performances of 5,625 pieces by 483 composers, 21,763 hours total.

papers.title: KernelBench-X: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
papers.abstract: 176 tasks across 15 categories for LLM Triton kernel generation evaluation.

papers.title: Prescriptive Scaling Laws for Data Constrained Training
papers.abstract: Additive overfitting penalty model for data-constrained training regimes.
